text: {"name":"wlan_usb_rx_dispatch","confidence":"high","docstring":"Validates received USB wireless frames and dispatches advertising reports or queues WLAN messages for ioctl handling.","subsystem":"wlan","var_renames":{"a1":"rx_frame","a2":"rx_length","v3":"rx_event_count","v4":"rx_status","v9":"frame_type","v10":"declared_length","v11":"rx_queue_state","v12":"queued_count","v14":"queue_slot_index","v15":"queue_entry"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":0,"meaning":"Low byte of the frame's encoded length."},{"offset":1,"meaning":"Upper length bits, masked to the low nibble."},{"offset":2,"meaning":"Frame type: 1 for an advertising report or 17 for a WLAN message."},{"offset":4,"meaning":"Frame payload begins here; in a queue entry, this offset stores the frame pointer."},{"offset":16,"meaning":"Queue-entry frame length."}]}
